question: what are the walking directions from the central garage to the fine-arts library

steps.output:
# Walking directions: Central Grounds Parking (garage) → Fine Arts Library (Fiske Kimball)
- **Mode**: walking
- **From**: Central Grounds Parking (garage) — Central Grounds Parking on the campus map — the multi-level garage near Emmet / University Ave area
- **To**: Fine Arts Library (Fiske Kimball) — Arts area on Central Grounds
- **Map used**: Central Grounds official map (https://www.fm.virginia.edu/docs/ges/ADA_Regions_CentralGrounds.pdf)

## Directions (from the campus map)
1. Exit Central Grounds Parking onto McCormick Road and turn right, heading past the Bookstore and Shannon Library on your left.
2. Continue straight as McCormick curves uphill toward University Chapel, keeping Clemons Library on your left.
3. Pass the Rotunda on your right and continue north onto University Avenue.
4. Walk past Madison Hall and Bayly Museum, staying on University Avenue as it curves toward Carr's Hill.
5. Fayerweather Hall (home of the Fine Arts Library / Fiske Kimball) will be just ahead on your right, past Carr's Hill and the President's House.

Approximate walking time: 10–12 minutes.
